name: Energy & Climate Systems Lab
tagline: Advancing energy transitions, climate policy, and decarbonization pathways
institution: School of Industrial Engineering, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso (PUCV)
mission: Generate rigorous scientific knowledge to accelerate the global energy transition, integrating advanced mathematical modeling, climate policy analysis, and sustainable development frameworks to inform real-world decision-making.
vision: To become the leading research hub in the Southern Hemisphere for integrated energy–climate–economy modeling, empowering the next generation of engineers and policymakers to design evidence-based, equitable decarbonization pathways.
